action.name: Comprimi in file .zip
action.command: sh -c 'cd "$(dirname "$1")" && n="$(basename "$1")"; n="${n%.*}"; [ $# -gt 1 ] && n="Archivio"; 7z a -tzip -- "$n.zip" "$@" >/dev/null && notify-send -i package-x-generic "Compresso" "$n.zip"' _ %F
action.description: Crea un archivio .zip con i file selezionati

action.name: Estrai qui
action.command: sh -c 'for f in "$@"; do if command -v unar >/dev/null; then unar -q -f -d -o "$(dirname "$f")" -- "$f" || exit 1; else d="${f%.*}"; 7z x -y -o"$d" -- "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; fi; done; notify-send -i extract-archive "Estratto" "$(basename "$1")"' _ %F
action.description: Estrae l'archivio in una cartella con lo stesso nome

action.name: Avvia con scheda grafica dedicata
action.description: Usa la scheda grafica più potente

action.name: Invia al telefono
action.command: sh -c 'command -v localsend_app >/dev/null && exec localsend_app; command -v localsend >/dev/null && exec localsend; exec kdeconnect-app'
action.description: Manda i file al telefono con LocalSend
